description.name: CubePath
description.tagline: Turn the CubePath VPS catalog into WHMCS products in a few clicks.
description.long: Companion addon for the CubePath server module. It reads plans, locations and operating systems from the CubePath API and creates ready-to-sell WHMCS products with pricing, configurable options and the custom fields the server module needs. Choose which locations and templates your customers can order, and keep existing products in sync with the CubePath catalog.
features: Create one product per CubePath plan, or all plans at once with a markup
Location and operating system configurable options built for you
Show or hide locations and templates on the order form
One-click sync of existing products with the CubePath catalog
Out-of-stock plans and apps that need more RAM are filtered out
